chapter_title: Chương 20: Trung Tâm Cai Nghiện Internet

segments.title: Chương 20: Trung Tâm Cai Nghiện Internet
segments.content:
After breakfast, Chen Guiliang followed his cousin-uncle downstairs.

As the motorcycle approached a school, Feng Tao pointed at the building up ahead and said, "The studio is in there."

The old building had no elevator, so they had to climb up to the fifth floor.

Standing outside a door, Feng Tao cautioned him, "Be polite to everyone you meet, especially Gang Ge and Yang Ge. You can't call them 'Ge' like I do; after all, there's a generational gap. You can call them Boss Tao and Boss Yang."

"Got it." Chen Guiliang was very obedient.

In Feng Tao's eyes, Chen Guiliang was just a teenager.

He thought all this talk of business was pure nonsense, nothing more than the boastful talk of a young boy.

He had agreed to bring Chen Guiliang to the game studio merely to let his nephew see the world and maybe play some games to pass the weekend.

Feng Tao continued to instruct, "Once we're inside, don't touch anything. If you want to play a game, ask Yang Ge first. He'll find an open computer for you when he has a chance."

Chen Guiliang put on the look of an honest kid, "I'll remember that."

"Knock, knock, knock!"

Only then did Feng Tao knock on the door.

A teenager with a messy, bird's-nest-like hairdo opened the door, rubbing his drowsy eyes. "Who are you looking for?"

"I'm a friend of your boss," Feng Tao said.

The teenager said nothing more, yawning as he let them in.

Good heavens!

Chen Guiliang had barely stepped inside before he was nearly driven out by the stench.

The room was filled with smoke, like some celestial realm. Besides the extremely strong smell of cigarettes, there was also a mix of instant noodle odor, smelly feet, body odor, and a musty smell!

Computers lined the walls, each with a young person sitting in front of it.

Some were slumped over their desks, already asleep.

They were playing the most popular online games of the time, mechanically gold farming and leveling up day after day.

When any hobby turns into a job, it becomes a tedious and boring affair.

Gaming was no exception.

Unlike the excited players in an internet cafe, these guys looked more dispirited and listless than the next.

Feng Tao said, "Most of them are minors addicted to online games. They heard they could play games for free here and even get a salary every month, so they eagerly ran over to sign up for gold farming. They work in two shifts, twelve hours each, with breaks for meals and the restroom. They can sleep if they're tired, but there's a daily quota. If they don't meet it, their pay gets docked."

"It really is an internet addiction treatment center," Chen Guiliang remarked with a sigh.

Feng Tao said with amusement, "The one who lasted the shortest time was here for only two days before disappearing, didn't even come back for his pay. At the beginning of this year, there was a high school senior who actually kicked his internet addiction here and went back to school to study obediently. Even though he only got into a junior college, his parents still sent a silk banner. Look, over there on the wall."

Chen Guiliang turned and looked up to see a silk banner embroidered with several lines of characters: "Saving a Lost Youth, A Kindness Remembered in Our Hearts — Respectfully Presented by Parent Hu Guogang."

What a load of bullshit!

"Welcome, Boss Feng, for your inspection." A young man walked out from an inner room, wearing flip-flops and grinning as he came over to greet them.

Feng Tao said with a chuckle, "Boss Yang is getting rich."

The young man said, "Rich my ass, I run into nothing but trouble all day long."

Feng Tao introduced him, "This is Yang Yuhui, my high school classmate. He and Boss Tao are partners in this studio."

Chen Guiliang understood.

The big boss behind the scenes, Tao Chenggang, had teamed up with his high school classmate Feng Tao to open a computer store. He'd also teamed up with another high school classmate, Yang Yuhui, to set up a game studio for grinding.

"This is my nephew, Chen Guiliang, a top student at County No. 2 High School, the kind who can easily get into a key university."

"Hello, Boss Yang."

"Hello, hello, come sit inside. It stinks out here."

Inside, there was a small room which served as Yang Yuhui's office. Besides a computer, there was also a folding cot.

"Smoke?" Yang Yuhui offered him a Red Pagoda Mountain cigarette.

Chen Guiliang took it casually. "Thanks."

Yang Yuhui tossed another cigarette to Feng Tao and lit one for himself, complaining, "I don't even want to do this anymore. This bunch of young brats is so hard to manage. Parents come to cause trouble every few days. A couple of days ago, they almost smashed my computers."

"Money is hard to earn, and shit is hard to eat. Just hang in there a bit longer," Feng Tao advised.

Yang Yuhui went on complaining for a while, showing that he and Feng Tao were close friends.

Chen Guiliang sat silently to the side.

Before long, it grew lively outside as another group of teenagers arrived for their shift change.

Yang Yuhui said to Chen Guiliang, "You can wait here. I have to check their performance from last night and then take them downstairs for breakfast."

Chen Guiliang stood up to see him off. "Please, Boss Yang, go ahead."

Feng Tao also left, he had to go to the store to do business.

Bored, Chen Guiliang began to carefully observe the office.

Soon, he turned on the tap, filled a kettle with water, and went to water the nearly dehydrated ball cactus on the windowsill.

He waited until almost ten in the morning, but the boss, Tao Chenggang, still hadn't arrived.

Enduring the nauseating smell of the studio, Chen Guiliang went outside to watch the internet-addicted teens gold farming and grinding.

After watching for a while, Chen Guiliang asked, "Doesn't The Legend of Mir have an offline leveling bot? You're still relying on manual power leveling?"

"You wish."

Yang Yuhui took a long drag from his Red Pagoda Mountain, fighting poison with poison against the secondhand smoke. "The Legend of Mir has only been online for a little over a hundred days. A lot of hacks haven't been developed yet, and Shanda is cracking down hard on them too. A while ago, a long-distance item-looting hack came out, but it was completely shut down within two days."

Chen Guiliang walked to a corner and stopped in front of a computer. "Is this Fantasy Westward Journey?"

"Boss Tao got two of the first closed beta spots through a friend's connection," Yang Yuhui said. "It's been in closed beta for 9 days now. Although there are still a lot of bugs, this game will probably be a hit. Whichever game gets popular, we'll get into it."

Chen Guiliang was suddenly reminded of that "China's First Father," who had risen to prominence through this very game, Fantasy Westward Journey.

His idol!

That "China's First Father" openly solicited young, beautiful women to bear his children, with a clear price tag for each birth. His small life goal was to have fifty children.

By the time of Chen Guiliang's rebirth, the "First Father" had already shown off 13 children on Weibo and claimed to have more than a dozen others he hadn't shown.

The feminists couldn't beat him.

Yang Yuhui usually ate and lived at the studio, facing a group of internet-addicted teens all day. He probably hadn't had a normal conversation with someone in a long time.

So he was quite talkative, proactively introducing various games to Chen Guiliang.

"This is The Legend of Mir 3, licensed by GZ-CAN," Yang Yuhui cursed. "GZ-CAN is a bunch of idiots. They licensed the game from Korea but insisted on modifying it themselves. It has even more bugs than Fantasy Westward Journey. A few days ago, they suddenly got rid of the monthly subscription card, and half the players have already left. The prices of gold and equipment have plummeted, catching me completely off guard. I still have some stuff I haven't been able to offload!"

Chen Guiliang smiled. "You should just have a bargain basement sale. If you wait any longer, no one will buy it at all."

Yang Yuhui blew a smoke ring. "I'll wait a bit longer. We'll pull our people out first, but leave the accounts and equipment as they are. After GZ-CAN releases their virtual cards, maybe we can recoup some of the losses."

One could only say that GZ-CAN was a magical company.

Every month, they would pull some stunt that drove players away. A true masterclass in shooting oneself in the foot!

"Screech!"

The shabby door outside opened, and Tao Chenggang arrived with his girlfriend.

His girlfriend was very young, probably still a student. A small section of her hair was dyed with rainbow streaks. As soon as she entered, she covered her nose and backed out. "Honey, it smells so bad in here. I'm not going in."

"Then wait in the car." Tao Chenggang's tone was a little displeased.

This game studio was one of his passion projects.

He had excitedly brought his girlfriend to inspect his kingdom, only to have her find his kingdom too dilapidated.

"Gang Ge, you son of a bitch, you're finally here!" Yang Yuhui went over to greet him with a grin.

Tao Chenggang took out a carton of Chunghwa cigarettes and tossed it to him from a distance as a reward.

Yang Yuhui casually pocketed the Chunghwas and made the introduction, "This is Feng Tao's nephew. He's been waiting for you for a while."

Chen Guiliang stepped forward to shake his hand. "Hello, Boss Tao. Sorry to intrude."

While shaking hands, Tao Chenggang quickly sized Chen Guiliang up.

His first impression was of a poor student. His entire outfit, from head to toe, was worth at most a hundred yuan.

The sleeves of his cheap jacket were frayed from washing, and there was even a hole at the elbow.

The seam on the side of his pants had split and been sewn back together by himself, crooked and twisted like a wriggling centipede.

His shoes weren't as worn out, but they were just some no-name brand worth thirty or fifty yuan.

However, his expression was calm, and his demeanor was composed.

There were dozens of internet-addicted teens in the studio, all of them dressed better than Chen Guiliang. But if you compared them in terms of temperament, Chen Guiliang seemed to be standing on a cloud, while the internet addicts were buried in the dirt.

Tao Chenggang took out another pack of Chunghwas and pressed it into Chen Guiliang's hand, saying, "Your cousin-uncle is my friend, so that makes you my junior. Take this pack of cigarettes as a meeting gift."

Thinking of me as a freeloader?

Chen Guiliang smiled. "Then I should give Boss Tao a meeting gift in return."

"What are you planning to give me?" Tao Chenggang asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "A fortune."

"Hahaha!"

Tao Chenggang was instantly amused, bursting into laughter. The phrase reminded him of the storytelling performances he listened to as a child, and he didn't take it seriously. "Let's talk in the office. The smell out here is pretty strong."

Yang Yuhui followed them in, plopped himself onto the cot, and sprawled out. "Gang Ge, you got a new girlfriend again? Is this one still in school?"

"The school belle of the Tourism Vocational High School," Tao Chenggang showed off proudly.

Yang Yuhui immediately gritted his teeth. "I'm going to report you for harming an underage girl!"

Tao Chenggang said, "She's of age. It's not illegal."

After beating around the bush, Yang Yuhui finally revealed his purpose. "Have your girlfriend introduce me to one of her classmates. I don't want anyone who's not pretty!"

"No problem. I'll take you to the vocational school on Monday and you can pick one yourself," Tao Chenggang said with a smile.

"That's more like it." Yang Yuhui closed his eyes to sleep.

Chen Guiliang had been observing them silently.

The way these two interacted gave him a rather good impression of Tao Chenggang.

Although he was rich, he didn't put on airs.

And after becoming successful, he was still bringing his old friends along to get rich with him.

Tao Chenggang swiveled his computer chair to face Chen Guiliang and asked as if teasing a child, "Young man, what kind of fortune are you going to give me?"

Chen Guiliang didn't mention making a private server at all. He only took out the A4 paper with his pay-to-win game development plan. "Boss Tao can take a look at this first."

Tao Chenggang took it casually.

Just a poor student, no matter how calm and sophisticated he seemed, what useful thing could he possibly come up with?

If it weren't for Feng Tao's sake, Tao Chenggang wouldn't have even bothered to meet Chen Guiliang.

Tao Chenggang tossed Chen Guiliang a Chunghwa, lit one for himself, and lowered his head to read the papers.

The concept of free-to-play games and their business model?

At first, Tao Chenggang was just skimming, but soon he fell into deep thought.

As he read, he extinguished the half-smoked Chunghwa and turned back to the first page from the second to reread it.

Seeing his expression, Chen Guiliang was suddenly a little surprised.

I was just testing the waters. My real intention is to make a private server. You're not actually going to bet your fortune and develop a pay-to-win game yourself, are you?

The nouveau riche who made it big back then were all a daring bunch.
